browser/ad-blocking.title: Ad Blocking
browser/ad-blocking.description: Ad blocking is disabled by default. You need to enable it manually if you want to block ads.

browser/bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
browser/bookmarks.description: Bookmark your favorite websites or create quick access links. Supports creating subfolders.

browser/browser-tool-menu.title: Browser Tool Menu
browser/browser-tool-menu.description: Access browser tools and settings from the tool menu.

browser/browsing-history.title: Browsing History
browser/browsing-history.description: Stores the user's browsing history, grouped by date.

browser/download-file.title: Download File
browser/download-file.description: The browser supports downloading most audio, video, image, document, and other file formats.

browser/overview.title: Overview
browser/overview.description: Lunascape provides a fast and secure mobile browser. Enhance your experience with built-in ad blocking and Web3 DApp support.

browser/private-mode.title: Private Mode
browser/private-mode.description: Browse privately without saving history or cookies (iOS only).

browser/search.title: Search
browser/search.description: Quick search using the provided search engines.

browser/share.title: Share
browser/share.description: Share web pages with other apps or save them to your device.

browser/tab-operations.title: Tab Operations
browser/tab-operations.description: The default maximum number of tabs opened is 12. Users can change the maximum number of tabs in Settings (Settings -> Tab -> Set Maximum Tab). We recommend that the maximum number should not be too large to avoid affecting browsing performance.

browser/web3-dapp-support.title: Web3 DApp Support
browser/web3-dapp-support.description: Connect to Web3 DApps and interact with them using your wallet.

home/browser-shortcuts.title: Browser Shortcuts
home/browser-shortcuts.description: Provides quick access to Shortcuts Setting and installed websites.

home/news.title: News
home/news.description: Provides quick shortcuts to the News screen and articles. The article list is taken from the RSS feed that is installed in the settings.

home/quick-search.title: Quick Search
home/quick-search.description: Quick search using the installed search engine, also supports quick access by scanning QR code.

home/tool-menu.title: Tool Menu
home/tool-menu.description: Provides shortcuts for quick access to features such as Bookmarks, History, Wallet, Downloads, Private Browser (iOS only), Browser Settings.

home/wallets.title: Wallets
home/wallets.description: Provides quick access to web3 wallet. Shows account balance, token list and token information.

index.title: Getting Started
index.description: Lunascape Mobile is a powerful, feature-rich mobile browser that combines traditional web browsing with cutting-edge Web3 capabilities. Built for modern users who demand both performance and innovation, Lunascape offers seamless integration of blockchain technology, news aggregation, and advanced browsing features in a single, intuitive interface.

news/news-sources-selection.title: News Sources Selection
news/news-sources-selection.description: Here you can review your news sources after an update.

settings/general.title: General
settings/general.description: General customizations for Home, Tab, Browser, Widget.

settings/overview.title: Overview
settings/overview.description: Configure various settings for the Lunascape browser to customize your browsing experience.

wallet/asset-list.title: Asset List
wallet/asset-list.description: This is the screen that shows the balance information and all tokens of the currently selected wallet, and a few other features.

wallet/create-wallet.title: Create Wallet
wallet/create-wallet.description: Users can create a new wallet or import an existing wallet using seed phrase.

wallet/overview.title: Overview
wallet/overview.description: Lunascape provides users with an EVM Wallet. Supports most EVM blockchains such as Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, Polygon, Avalanche C-Chain, Fantom, Arbitrum, Optimism...

wallet/wallet-dashboard.title: Wallet Dashboard
wallet/wallet-dashboard.description: The selected account's overview information is displayed such as Account Name, Network, Total Balance, Assets, Transaction History and Footer.

wallet/walletconnect.title: WalletConnect
wallet/walletconnect.description: WalletConnect is an open source protocol that enables secure connection between crypto wallets and decentralized applications (dApps) via QR codes or deep links. It allows users to sign transactions and authenticate without sharing private keys directly with the dApp.
